title: Gauss and the History of the Fast Fourier Transform
version: Archive for History of Exact Sciences 34(3), pp. 265–277, doi:10.1007/BF00348431.
lineage: University of Washington copy of the authors’ historical investigation. Their technical distinction is independent scholarship. Their influence wording about Good is explicitly an interpretation of the 1965 publication.

passages.note: Distinguishes the two algorithms and identifies Good’s method as the prime-factor algorithm. Describes the reference to Good as influence based on the wording of the 1965 publication, without dating contact or identifying a separate witness.
